title: Jersey City Developers
note: Major developers' Jersey City buildings, placed on their tax parcels. Each building lists the role each company played (developer, co-developer, owner or manager) as reported by the developer or the press. Kushner Companies (Charles, Jared and Nicole Kushner) and KRE Group (Jonathan Kushner) are separate companies.

developers.label: Greystar
developers.note: Greystar's Jersey City role found so far is property management and leasing, not development.

developers.label: Rockpoint (owner)
developers.note: Rockpoint is an owner/investor here, not the original developer.

developers.label: Owner of record (developer not yet identified)
developers.note: Found in the NJ tax records (built 2010 or later, 100+ units). Owner names are withheld from the state's public tax data under Daniel's Law, so the owner shown is the grantee on the latest deed in the Hudson County Register index.

buildings.name: The Journal (One Journal Square)
buildings.summary: Twin 52-story residential towers over a 12-story base next to the Journal Square PATH, about 40,000 SF of retail. Renamed The Journal in Nov 2024.
buildings.lots_label: Block 9501 · Lot 23 (tower condos at 18 and 36 Journal Sq)

buildings.name: 30 Journal Square (proposed tower)
buildings.summary: Redesigned 71-story residential tower with a 14,000 SF public plaza, designed by Marchetto Higgins Stieve. Needs Planning Board approval of site plan amendments (P2025-0264).

buildings.name: 65 Bay Street (Trump Bay Street)

buildings.name: Sable (Jersey City Urby)
buildings.summary: 69-story rental tower on the Harborside waterfront, built by Ironstate and Mack-Cali as Jersey City Urby and renamed Sable. Veris (formerly Mack-Cali) bought Ironstate's 15% stake for $39 million. Tax record: 70 stories, 763 units.

developers.role: Co-developer; sole owner since buying out Ironstate
